description: Regione Calabria - Rete Geodetica planoaltimetrica GPS 2008 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. The network, built for cartographic purposes, has a mesh of 7Km and contains a network for urban areas; the GPS geodetic network is the reference for the geodetic framework of the points of support for the new regional technical map 1:5000 and forms the geographical basis of the new regional topographical DB. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Calabria Region — GPS 2008 Planoaltimetrica Geodetic Network" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
